findings.issue: Module-level log() calls real datetime.now() directly instead of the injected clock, a literal (cosmetic-only) deviation from the strategy contract's 'no datetime.now() outside client/clock/sleeper' rule. Neutralized in the backtest by monkey-patching strat.log (backtest_opening_range_breakout_orb.py:40-46), so it has no effect on sim decisions/prices; same pre-existing pattern as nifty_direction_ce_pe.py.
findings.fix: Have log() accept/use an injected clock (e.g. pass self.now into log calls or make log a bound method) so the live script itself is contract-clean without needing the backtest override.

findings.issue: Stop/target checks use the last completed 1-minute bar's CLOSE as 'LTP', not intrabar high/low. On 2026-10-16 NIFTY touched a high of 23080.50 at 10:13 (above the 23076.55 stop) a full minute before the bar-close trigger fired at 10:14 (close 23094.30), so the simulated stop fill is later/different than a live tick-driven stop would be.
findings.fix: Document this explicitly as an accepted v1 fill-model limitation (already partly documented); consider an optional high/low-based stop check for strategies that rely on intrabar execution, if closer fidelity is later required.
